mcp_tools.name: agent_evaluation_scorecard
mcp_tools.title: Agent evaluation scorecard
mcp_tools.description: Submit an agent-evaluation evidence manifest; get a deterministic TRUSTED / NOT_TRUSTED / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE scorecard across eight sections (task suite, reproducible runs, judging, regression gates, beyond accuracy, incident replay, scorecard, benchmark hygiene), including a computed per-task acceptance check against declared cost/latency allowances, with per-check evidence.

inputSchema.description: The agent-evaluation evidence manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table).

suite.description: Task-suite evidence (versioned, criteria written before the run, acceptance criteria per task).

judging.description: Judging evidence (deterministic checks first, LLM-judge calibration/blinding, self-judging).

tasks.description: Declared task results: {name, passed, cost, allowed_cost, latency_ms, allowed_latency_ms, safety_violation}.
